description: What a public project shows of the company's OTHER projects: issues and wiki pages shown there by reference, not copied — anybody who reads the public project reads them as they are now, while the rest of their project stays closed and their links to it are counted, never named. Each row: its id (for remove_from_showcase), whether it is an issue or a page, its key or page id, its title and the project it belongs to; for a page its edition — 'current', or 'approved' with the version in force (null while none stands, and then it shows nothing). Whoever manages it also sees rows that show nothing now, with shown: false. Also whether you may add to it.

projectKey.description: Key of the public project, e.g. 'D5'.
